pages.text: $(k:hominin_evolution.journal) opens your journal. Stats: your species and sex, health and water, ticks, illness, what is stopping you healing, your mate and your band, and how many bands your species can still lose.

Skills: everything you know by name, and everything you don't as ???. They are learned by doing - knapping, termite fishing, cracking marrow, making fire, tracking, grooming, calming a troop, thinking.$(br2)Pick one to see what it gives you and whether it survives evolving.

Event log: what cannot wait - your water and hunger, a need in the band and how long is left, who is expecting, a band demanding something or on its way, the season - and the last of the urgent news, each with its day. Urgent news also crosses the top of your screen, and chat marks it: [Need], [Warning], [Danger], [Season], [Band].
$(l)Teach$() under $(k:hominin_evolution.social): choose a skill and do it in front of the band, and those watching learn it. Children learn what their minder knows as they grow.
